policy: Font-measured glyph bounds plus fixed horizontal 12px and vertical 4px halos, including the existing edge offset. The initial horizontal 4px halo nearly clipped wider reference titles; widened uniformly after development-only visual inspection. Canonical windows come from unchanged renderer commands, never from per-scan fitting. Paired edge, Census and local-contrast scores remain separate.
note: Development-only diagnostic. Neutral fill previously failed reserved transfer and is not adopted. Shared translations are hypotheses for a future frozen study; no card or scan is repositioned.
